notes: Standard Deduction Worksheet for Dependents, line 2: the larger of $1,350 (tax.us.2025.parameter.dependent-standard-deduction-floor, Rev. Proc. 2024-40 Sec. 3.15(2), unchanged by Pub. L. 119-21) or earned income plus $450 (tax.us.2025.parameter.dependent-earned-income-addon, same citation). max(floor, income+450) is the worksheet's own 'is earned income more than $900' test exactly (P0 Sec. 2/Contract item 4): at or below $900, income+450 <= 1350 so the floor wins; above $900, income+450 > 1350 so the addition wins -- no separate $900 parameter is needed or declared. Earned income on the bounded supported class is Form 1040 line 1z, published as tax.us.2025.wages.total-w2-box1 (P0 Sec. 5; same symbol rule.ss-benefits-worksheet already names as 'line 1z (bounded wages)').
